info.title: Microsoft 365 Outlook Universal API
info.description: Access Microsoft 365 Outlook mail through Microsoft Graph, including messages, folders, attachments, replies, forwarding, and sending mail for the signed-in user.

post.description: Adds a file attachment to a message in Microsoft 365 Outlook.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

messageId.description: The draft or message ID to attach the file to.

contentType.description: MIME type of the attachment content.

contentBytes.description: Base64-encoded file content. Microsoft Graph supports this action for attachments under 3 MB.
Base64-encoded attachment content returned by Microsoft Graph.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the attachment was last modified.
